rule: Every published value traces to an official page read in-session; the pack is non-commercial and informational only.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Prevents results that cannot be lawfully or factually reproduced from reaching the board.

rule: market_line and line_difference stay blank in every table until a licensed/official price source exists.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: A fabricated benchmark cannot manufacture apparent skill.

rule: Every originated market must carry an open row and a close row in price_snapshots.csv; close rows stay blank until captured at the close window.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Locks the opening number before information arrives and records the closing number honestly.

rule: Side (spread) rows are originated first (wave 1), totals second (wave 2), moneylines third (wave 3); the checker enforces order.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Keeps market-type cherry-picking out: the side is committed before the total and moneyline exist.

rule: Backtests and ROI settle only against results_feed.csv rows verified from official game pages.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Settlement against unverified scores is the fastest way to launder luck into skill.

rule: At least 200 graded selections per strategy family before any performance statistic is official.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Small samples are dominated by variance; the floor stops a short lucky run from qualifying.

rule: Parameters are fitted strictly on data before the test window; no same-window fitting.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Removes in-sample optimism (the retrospective W9 grades are labelled in-sample for exactly this reason).

rule: Leaderboard publishes signal metrics and staking metrics in separate columns; staking cannot escalate a failed signal (staking_can_escalate_signal=no).
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: A lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal.

rule: Replacement events record the depth of the replacement (string level), not only the fact of a replacement; strings blank unless a club depth chart was read.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Third- and fourth-string exposure is a distinct risk regime from a straight backup swap.

rule: Every published correlation value comes from officially sourced numbers and publishes n beside the value.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Unsourced or n-less correlations are indistinguishable from noise.

rule: Model inputs older than 7 days at kickoff require a re-read before the close snapshot is valid.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: Stale inputs silently convert a live model into a lagging one.

rule: No strategy may sit live while any demotion rule is unevaluable for its tracked statistics.
why_it_removes_luck_or_error: A demotion gate that cannot fire is decoration.
